name: aspiration
quote: Someday I'd like to bowl a perfect game.
description: A desire to achieve a particular goal someday without a specific plan to reach it.

commentaries.quote: To understand the heart and mind of a person, look not at what he has already achieved, but what he aspires to.
Aspiration is a tough little weed. If there's no progress to where it points, you may feel slow. But if it dies, you'll be completely lost.
Aspiration first. Then ambition. Then either success or failure. Then again.

conditions: A desire to achieve a particular goal someday.
